overloads.semanticRole: The WEB Validate digest command checks the validity of the identifying information (name and password) provided by a user connecting to the Web server.

constraints: Must be called from the On Web Authentication database method, in the context of Web authentication in Digest mode.
Digest validation cannot be used jointly with 4D passwords.
If the browser does not support Digest authentication, an authentication error is raised instead of this command returning False.
